rows.en: [VAR6], Goro Watari, created the psychic power amplifier Zeber from a part of his own body.
With his new power, Zeber, in hand, Goro Watari takes on Emperor Banba!
Banba! Where are you?

[VAR6], it's too late! The Japanese archipelago will sink any moment now… 10 minutes left!

It seems the time has come to settle things with you too. Can you beat me? [VAR6]…
I shall win, without fail!!
There's no time! If we don't stop the crustal deformation device quickly, there'll be a disaster…
There's no time! If we don't stop the crustal deformation device quickly, there'll be a disaster…
There's no time! If we don't stop the crustal deformation device quickly, there'll be a disaster…
What should I do? What should I do…
What should I do? What should I do…
What should I do? What should I do…

Security Team… arriving now.

It appears the TDF-related facilities in this district have been seized by the Phantom Army… Leave them to us!
I heard from Mr. Tachibana… He said you got a call from the Neo-Humans and ran straight out, didn't you?
Goro, your enemies are our enemies too! Don't go trying to look cool all by yourself…
I heard from Mr. Tachibana… He said you got a call from the Neo-Humans and ran out.
Goro, your enemies are our enemies too, you know! Please don't try to look cool all by yourself…
Everyone!? Why?
Everyone!? Why?
Everyone!? Why?
The TDF also picked up suspicious movements by the Phantom Army. It looks like this will be an all-out battle.
Goro, don't be a stranger! Leave it to Annie!
SSI also picked up suspicious movements by the Phantom Army. It's going to be an all-out battle, so be careful!
The TDF also picked up suspicious movements by the Phantom Army. It looks like this will be an all-out battle.

EAGLE also picked up suspicious movements by the Phantom Army! This is going to be an all-out battle!
Emperor Banba has planted a crustal deformation device! It'll explode in under 10 minutes. If it does, Japan will sink!
Emperor Banba has planted a crustal deformation device! It'll explode in under 10 minutes. If it does, Japan will sink!
Emperor Banba has planted a crustal deformation device! It'll explode in under 10 minutes. If it does, Japan will sink!
What!? Damn the Phantom Army, I won't forgive them! We have to stop it, no matter what! Let's go!
What!? The Phantom Army, pulling a dirty trick like that… Let's stop it, no matter what! Let's go!
Ba~rabarabara, Banbaaa! Let's settle this, Goro Watari!
Gigant!? Naager's in on this too?
Gigant!? Naager's in on this too?
Gigant!? Naager's in on this too?
Uwaaagh!!
Uwaaagh!!
5 minutes have passed! 5 minutes left!
5 minutes have passed! 5 minutes left!
5 minutes have passed! 5 minutes left!
8 minutes have passed! 2 minutes left! Damn, will we make it!?
8 minutes have passed! 2 minutes left! Damn, will we make it!?
8 minutes have passed! 2 minutes left! Damn, will we make it!?
1 minute left! Damn you, Banba!
1 minute left! Damn you, Banba!
1 minute left! Damn you, Banba!

…!?

Were we too late!?

Were we too late!?

Were we too late!?

Ba~rabarabara, Banbaaa!

Look well upon my true form!! Flame Fighter!! Porteutoiyanutumaa!!
Flame Fighter? Emperor Banba, is that your true form!?
Flame Fighter? Emperor Banba, is that your true form!?
Flame Fighter? Emperor Banba, is that your true form!?

You, at least, I'll defeat, even if it costs me my life! Curse you, [VAR6]… Behold the burning life of Emperor Banba!!

Ba~rabarabara, Banbaaa!

Where's the crustal deformation device? …!?

Toooh!!

Where's the crustal deformation device? …!?

Chestooo!!

Where's the crustal deformation device? …!?

Chestooo!!
Emperor Banba… He truly was a demon king out of hell!
…I've defeated the Neo-Human Empire. At last… I've avenged my mother!

Makoto Arai, Interpol secret agent… I'm investigating the movements of the Neo-Humans.

Though on the surface, I'm an executive of the Anti-Destron League…

I know everything about you. Fuhrer Geisel's Desper Army is even more cold-blooded and ruthless than the Phantom Army. Let's cooperate with each other.
Now, a new battle is about to begin.
Defeat Emperor Banba and the entire Phantom Army! However, if the battle isn't over within 10 turns, the crustal deformation device will explode.
Defeat Flame Fighter! However, if the battle isn't over within 10 turns, the crustal deformation device will explode.
Defeat the entire Desper Army!
Goro Watari is defeated, or the crustal deformation device explodes

Attention, space boat traveling on Space Route 093X! What is your registry?

What is your purpose in heading to Earth? Space boat, respond! Respond!!
No identifying markings… It's a suspicious ship…

The ship's model is Gamma QR3…

This matches the model reported to us by the Dark Galaxy syndicate. It must belong to the Bell siblings, no doubt about it.
If we let those space warriors live, they'll be trouble later on… Eliminate them!
I shall go and crush them.
It's entered the atmosphere!
I'll go check it out!
Wait! A message from HQ.
Sharivan… do you know a woman named Rita?

Rita?

Yes… She's an alien libertarian, an organizer working for the extermination of evil organizations.

Her organization gathers volunteers scattered across the galaxy to fight Madou, Makuu, Fuuma and the like… Commander Kom, has something happened with her?
Yes… A message for you has arrived from Rita.
It was sent on tape… Transmitting it now!
